_comment: Curated large-cap US equity research universe. Used for broad-universe feature testing and shadow DL model training. NOT the published MAG7 forecast universe. Edit this list to adjust scope; re-run build_training_dataset.py --tickers $(python -c "import json; print(','.join(json.load(open('config/research_universe.json'))['tickers']))") --out data/research_panel.parquet

notes.size: 50 tickers — MAG7 + large-cap US equities across 7 sectors
notes.sectors: Tech (18), Healthcare (7), Financials (7), Consumer (9), Energy (2), Industrials (5), Other (2)
notes.excluded: Full S&P 500 intentionally excluded — too many illiquid/small-cap names that add noise without improving feature signal
notes.institutional_features: momentum_z/quality_z/value_z will be NaN for non-MAG7 tickers (institutional_features.parquet is MAG7-only). Price-derived features work for all tickers.
notes.published_universe: MAG7 only — monitor.py and report outputs are unchanged
